modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift and handing over shift to machine — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: reach the department at least 15-20 minutes earlier
take a round around the Machine
check the cleanliness of the Sanitary Napkin machine
check the ongoing material/lot on machine
check the availability of sufficient raw materials and auxiliaries required during the shift
discuss with previous shift machine operator regarding working of the machines. If any issue then report to Supervisor
check that the wastes collection is properly carried-out
take a charge of machine from the outgoing operator in a proper manner
take information regarding the machine stoppages or breakdown of machines, production and quality issues. If any report to the Supervisor
check the machine has to be properly handed over to the incoming machine operator
report to the Supervisor before leaving the department

modules.module_title: Operating of Sanitary Napkin Making Machine — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: check the quality and quantity of raw material to be used on machine before running the machine
check that control switches for starting, running and stopping of machine are functioning properly
operate the sanitary napkin machine
check that the flow of the Continuous process divides into four steps - wood pulveriser, core forming unit, wing making, packing unit
check the proper functioning of compressed sheet form of wood pulp passed into Pulverizer unit to open the sheet into individual fibres
check the proper functioning of Super Absorbent Polymer is laying over wood fluff/fibres and pressed in SAP feeding unit
check the functioning of sheet passing to bottom film feeding unit where glue film placed over core material.
check the proper functioning of the material psses over to cutting unit where required shape is given
check the proper working condition of Packing cum sealing unit
inspect the produced sanitary napkin is free from faults
identify the damaged caused in sanitary napkin produced in the shift
leave the work area safe and secure after work done
